text:
Kai: late-night dilemma  crank synthwave while I do dishes or rewatch a comfort rom-com and not think about dishes? voting and recs pls. :dishw

Lena: synthwave for chores. rec: Timecop1983 'Journeys' EP or The Midnight 'Kids'. up tempo but not annoying.

Marcus: rom-com all the way. rec: 'The Princess Bride' if you want comfort + quotable lines. also 'Crazy Rich Asians' for bright colors.

Ivy: if you want both: synthwave playlist + put rom-com on mute and read subtitles. somehow it works. :laughing:

Marta: book crossover rec: 'Eleanor Oliphant Is Completely Fine'  cozy-but-weirdly-uplifting, good for background while doing chores.

SnackBot: Quick poll created  option A: Synthwave, option B: Rom-com. Results after 5m: A 3, B 2.

Kai: thanks! also anyone have a short synthwave mix that's not too vaporwave-y? prefer warm synths.

Lena: quick mix I use:
1. Timecop1983 - Lovers (feat. SEAWAVES)
2. The Midnight - Days of Thunder
3. FM-84 - Running in the Night
4. Kavinsky - Nightcall (slower but moody)

Marcus: bookmarking the mix. rom-com rec for later: 'Notting Hill' + tea.

Ivy: added 'Eleanor Oliphant' to my to-read. Kai: go synthwave, you will dance with a sponge.

Kai: synthwave it is. shower concert with dishes. :sunglasses:
